game_title: Loop Picker – Fairy Ring Glade Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade, a glade ringed by mushrooms: the herbalist must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade: a glade ringed by mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Fairy Ring Glade, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round, a new spirit lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of spirit lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Loop Picker
